Juju.reason: Northern Dial's Juju entry comes from Rascalz's 'Can't Relate (feat. JUJU & Psycho Les)' on Global Warning. The exact release credit pairs JUJU with Psycho Les, identifying this guest as JuJu (Jerry Tineo) of the Beatnuts rather than an unrelated artist using the same alias. The Beatnuts' own artist profile identifies JuJu as Dominican American from Corona, Queens, New York, establishing that this exact artist is non-Canadian.
